title: Ten Plates and One Missing Arrow
subtitle: 发明与创造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 发明与创造（科学与技术·发明与创造）
meta: 主题语境：发明与创造（科学与技术·发明与创造）　|　核心词汇：diagram　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 diagram 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the draughtsman ① drew a diagram that no printer in the city would have engraved, and he said the drawing was the whole of the patent. The ② diagram, meaning the drawing and not the table, ran ten plates and stayed unexplained in the margin; a diagram, he said, is the only thing in a patent that is judged by how long it is left unlabelled.

Every ③ diagram in that patent had the same missing arrow at the side of it, and the ④ diagram at the end, meaning the one they kept for the engine and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever checked twice. A diagram, his assistant said, is nine parts ink and one part somebody willing to read; the draughtsman said the reading is the part that fills ten plates.

The statistician meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the diagram was the whole of the appendix, meaning the table and not the drawing. The ⑥ diagram, meaning the table and not any of that, is the only thing in an appendix that everybody prints and nobody reads; diagram, she said, is either something you draw or the only word that means both a drawing and a table. She said the table is the part they remember.

By 1957 the ⑦ diagram had become a line in a specification, and the specification had become an argument about the missing arrow. The ⑧ diagram of the whole thing, the draughtsman wrote in May, was one patent and ten plates of drawing; diagram, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to draw. She said the drawing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ diagram I remember is the one at the end, which was engraved in 1970 and is still described as the clearest in the patent. A ⑩ diagram, the assistant said in 1972, is the only thing that improves by being read; every diagram, she said, is a table that has agreed to look like a drawing. She said the table was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 图解；示意图（指专利里画出的那一张）
B. n. 示意图（指那张图本身，与那张表格相对）
C. 固定搭配：draw a diagram 画一张示意图
D. n. 示意图（指留给发动机用的那一张）
E. n. 图示；图解（抽象总称，指一份专利里的全部图示）
F. n. 图示（指说明书里写到、被列明的那一张）
G. n. 图表；一览表（指附录里印出的那一张）
H. n. 图表（抽象总称，指人人印出却无人细读的那张）

items.q: drew a diagram that no printer in the city would have engraved
The diagram, meaning the drawing and not the table
the diagram was the whole of the appendix

The diagram of the whole thing
A diagram, the assistant said in 1972

answers.why: draw a diagram 意为“画一张示意图”，1948 年制图员画了一张全城没有一位印工肯刻版的示意图。
diagram 意为“示意图”，指那张图本身而不是那张表格，它画了十幅图版而在页边没有说明。
diagram 意为“图解”，指那份专利里每一张图解，每一张旁边都缺着同一个箭头。
diagram 意为“示意图”，指留给发动机用的那一张，是唯一有人核对过两次的。
diagram 意为“图表、一览表”，指附录里印出的那一张，统计学家说这张图表就是那份附录的全部。
diagram 意为“图表”，指人人印出却无人细读的那张而不是那张图本身，是附录里人人都印出、却无人细读的东西。
diagram 意为“图示”，指说明书里写到、被列明的那一张，到 1957 年这张图示成了说明书里的一行。
diagram 意为“图示、图解”，制图员五月写道，整件事的图解是一份专利和十幅图版的绘制。
diagram 意为“示意图”，我记得的是末尾那一张，1970 年被刻版，至今仍被说成专利里最清楚的一张。
diagram 为抽象总称，助手 1972 年说，一张示意图是唯一会因为被细读而变得更好的东西。
